atomic_facts.fact: Warren Buffett has stepped down from the CEO role of Berkshire Hathaway.
Warren Buffett handed the CEO reins to Greg Abel approximately nine months before September 2026 (i.e., around January 2026).
As of 2026-10-01, Warren Buffett is not the CEO of Berkshire Hathaway.
Greg Abel assumed the CEO position of Berkshire Hathaway on January 1, 2026.
Greg Abel took over as CEO at the start of 2026.
As of 2026-10-01, Greg Abel is the CEO of Berkshire Hathaway.
